name: Primary Pediatric Heart Tumor

criteria.description: Detection of intracardiac mass by echocardiography or cardiac MRI
Histological confirmation of tumor type via biopsy or surgical specimen
Presence of cardiac symptoms such as arrhythmia or obstruction correlating with tumor location

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Imaging confirmation of intracardiac mass plus histopathological confirmation
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Biopsy may be contraindicated in some cases due to tumor location or patient stability

searchTerms: heart chamber tumor seen on ultrasound

pathognomonic.symptomName: Obstructive cardiac symptoms due to tumor mass effect
searchTerms: obstructive heart signs due to mass

common.symptomName: Heart failure signs such as tachypnea and hepatomegaly
searchTerms: signs of heart failure like fast breathing and enlarged liver
heart failure symptoms with breathlessness and swollen liver
tachypnea and hepatomegaly from heart problems

common.symptomName: Cyanosis due to impaired cardiac output
searchTerms: bluish skin from poor heart output
cyanosis due to low cardiac function
failure to gain weight as expected

occasional.symptomName: Embolic phenomena secondary to tumor fragmentation
Respiratory distress due to pulmonary venous obstruction
searchTerms: breathing difficulty from blocked lung veins
respiratory distress due to lung blood flow obstruction
shortness of breath from pulmonary venous blockage
pericardial fluid buildup with heart compression
blockage of blood vessels by emboli

rare.symptomName: Conduction block leading to heart block

laboratory: Non-specific elevation of inflammatory markers in some cases
Possible anemia secondary to chronic illness
imaging: Cardiac MRI for detailed tumor characterization
Chest X-ray showing cardiomegaly or pulmonary congestion
genetic: Association with tuberous sclerosis complex in cardiac rhabdomyomas
other: Histopathological examination confirming tumor type (e.g., rhabdomyoma, fibroma, myxoma)

redFlags: Progressive heart failure symptoms in infant
references: Maron BJ, et al. Primary cardiac tumors in children: clinical and pathologic features. Circulation. 2019.
Tuberous Sclerosis Complex Consensus Conference. Cardiac rhabdomyomas and associated tumors. Orphanet J Rare Dis. 2021.
